scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:content
scripts.validate: npm run build:web && node tools/content.mjs validate --stamp
scripts.dev: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && node tools/dev-server.mjs
scripts.db:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply advent --local
scripts.db:preview: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply advent-preview --remote --env preview
scripts.db:prod: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply advent --remote
scripts.e2e: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && node test/e2e.mjs
